instrument: Directive 2008/105/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 16 December 2008 on environmental quality standards in the field of water policy, as amended by Directive 2013/39/EU of 12 August 2013
version: Consolidated text 2008L0105, EN, 13.09.2013 (header '2008L0105 - EN - 13.09.2013 - 001.001'), Annex I Part A (environmental quality standards). The EUR-Lex consolidation list was not reachable (bot challenge). A secondary source reports a 2026 revision of the priority substances framework (Directive (EU) 2026/805); it was neither fetched nor read, so this set is the 2013 amended annex that the wave scope names, not the 2026 revision.

files.fetch: curl with request headers 'Accept: application/xhtml+xml' and 'Accept-Language: eng' (Publications Office content negotiation); the eur-lex.europa.eu HTML and PDF addresses answered with a bot challenge and no document
files.redistribution: committed under the Commission reuse decision below

terms.statement: Reuse of documents of the EU institutions published by the Publications Office, including EUR-Lex legal acts, is authorised under Commission Decision 2011/833/EU of 12 December 2011 on the reuse of Commission documents, which permits reuse for commercial and non-commercial purposes without charge and without individual application (Articles 1 to 6), except for documents covered by Article 2(2) (third-party intellectual property, logos, software).
terms.note: The EUR-Lex legal notice page (eur-lex.europa.eu/content/legal-notice/legal-notice.html) answered with a bot challenge and could not be read; the decision text itself was read.

mapping.freshwater: 'Inland surface waters' (rivers and lakes and related artificial or heavily modified water bodies, footnote 3)
mapping.marine: 'Other surface waters' (the annex does not define the term further; the set treats it as the marine and transitional column)
mapping.basis: AA-EQS = annual average; MAC-EQS = maximum allowable concentration; unit as printed, 'μg/l' for columns 4 to 7

omitted.biota: Column 8 (EQS biota, μg/kg wet weight) is not transcribed; the medium list is water and sediment only
omitted.notApplicableOrBlank: 56 water cells printed 'not applicable', 'see footnote' or left blank (including the AA-EQS water cells of brominated diphenylethers, hexachlorobenzene, hexachlorobutadiene and mercury, which the annex gives for biota only, and all dioxin water cells) produce no row
omitted.sediment: Annex I Part A prints no sediment standard
